title: Getting Started with PlusOS
summary: Introduction to PlusOS by the1Domo, system overview, hardware requirements, and your first boot.

title: Hardware Support & ROM Architectures
summary: Deep dive into Macintosh Plus (128K ROM) vs Macintosh SE (256K ROM), ADB, VIA, SCSI, and sound.

title: Bootloader & Kernel Relocation
summary: How loader.S executes from HFS boot blocks, places the kernel below BufPtr, and initializes the ROM.

title: Kernel Core & Dual-Ring Execution
summary: Ring-0 supervisor vs Ring-2 userland, A-line trap interception (vector 10), and exception recovery.

title: Dynamic RAM Management & Garbage Collection
summary: kmem dynamic heap, slab pools (32B to 512B), canary sentinels, garbage collector & compactor, RAM disk.

title: Preemptive Multitasking & IPC Subsystems
summary: Round-robin preemptive scheduler, delta timer wheels, FIFO pipes, semaphores, mutexes, and signals.

title: Desktop GUI & Multi-OS Theme Engine
summary: The desktop compositor, tear-free page flipping, 6 themes (System 7, Amiga, Win95/98, Aero, Hacker Matrix).

title: Classic Mac 'APPL' Executable Loader
summary: Parsing HFS Resource Forks, CODE 0 Jump Table synthesis, A5 World reconstruction, and _LoadSeg hooking.

title: PlusNET: DaynaPORT TCP/IP Stack
summary: Driving BlueSCSI WiFi / DaynaPORT over SCSI ID 4, ARP, IPv4, ICMP, UDP, DHCP, DNS, telnet, and IRC.

title: Fixed-Point 3D Engine & Graphics
summary: 16.16 fixed-point math on the 68000, 4x4 Bayer dithering, 2D polygons/hexagons, and 3D wireframe/solid meshes.

title: Complete Syscall ABI Reference (SYS 1-63)
summary: Full ABI documentation for all 63 PlusOS system calls, argument registers, data structures, and errors.

title: SDK & Application Development Guide
summary: Writing C applications using <plusos/...>, <plusrom/...>, and <serom/...>, linker scripts, and cross-compiling.

title: PlusOS Disk Studio & Compiler Pipeline
summary: Comprehensive guide to PlusOS Disk Studio (PlusOSDiskStudio.exe), native C++ GUI compiler, multi-threaded build pipeline, dual-boot configurator, live log streaming, software package checklist, compile directory auto-scanner, HFS explorer, and the crash-safe in-place Update button that refreshes the kernel + software on an existing disk while keeping all your files.

title: Minimal Bootable Floppy & Hard Drive Installer
summary: How to compile and write 800K and 1.44M Macintosh bootable floppies, minimal recovery footprint, installer.pex, capacity guidelines (<800 KB limit), and hardware provisioning.

title: Package Repository Server & Software Center
summary: Standalone dual HTTP (8088) and SSL/HTTPS (8443) package repository server, Cloudflare caching, pkg CLI, and pkgmgr GUI software center.

title: Macintosh LC III ROM Reverse-Engineering & Port
summary: 100% decompilation of the 1024 KB Universal SuperMario ROM ($067C), opcode signature mapping engine, dispatch table decompression, 68030 cache coherency, and C++ reimplementation.

title: Modular Kernel: Drivers, Services & Self-Healing
summary: Kernel modules (core/driver/service), the KModule lifecycle, named kpipe pipelines for inter-module messaging, and a supervisor that isolates and restarts failed modules so a crash is not a panic.

title: In-Kernel Crash Debugger & Post-Mortem Dumps
summary: On-screen debugger panel, full 68000 register capture, the PDMP post-mortem dump format written via raw ROM traps, and the plusdump CLI viewer with a dependency-free 68000 disassembler.

title: Universal Boot: One Image for Every 680x0 Mac
summary: A single PlusOS.hda that boots a Macintosh Plus, SE, Classic (68000) or LC III (68030), detecting the CPU via CPUFlag at $12F like System 7, plus run-time 68030 cache coherency, A-line dispatch, and Sonora video geometry.

title: OTA Update Server: Over-the-Air Updates
summary: Update PlusOS over the internet without reflashing. The standalone OTA server (FastAPI + WebSocket + SQLite) at ota.d0a.net via Cloudflare, signed per-compile publishing, content-addressed artifacts, the PlusOS Updater and native plusupdate clients, an AI assistant (LFM2-2.6B) that writes release notes and per-app changelogs, and an admin control panel with live system monitoring.

title: IKANET: Chat Client & Server
summary: A retro System 6/7-style chat network for PlusOS: accounts, rooms, DMs, 16x16 profile icons, and file/image sharing. A native Macintosh app (over PlusNET) and a web client share the same WebSocket server, so browser and 68000 users chat together.
